overview.name: Arimathea Catholic Bond Index ETF
overview.description: Under normal circumstances, at least 90% of the value of the fund’s assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, is invested in securities comprising the index, which, for the fund, are considered fixed-income securities. The index is a weighted index comprised of fixed-income securities.
